# Wire EDM Pro

> Sydney precision machining business with over 25 years of experience: wire EDM cutting, EDM hole drilling, CNC milling, CNC turning and laser cutting for manufacturing, mining, medical, defence and general engineering. Based at 16/24 Garling Rd, Kings Park NSW 2148, Australia.

## Solutions

- [EDM Wire Cutting Solution](https://wireedmpro.com.au/edm-wire-cutting/): Wire EDM to ±0.005 mm in hardened metal up to 420 mm tall, burr-free, any conductive metal
- [Milling solutions](https://wireedmpro.com.au/milling/): CNC milling on a DMG MORI ecoMill 600 V, jigs, fixtures, die sets and production runs
- [Turning solutions](https://wireedmpro.com.au/turning/): CNC turning and laser-cut sheet metal profiles
- [EDM Drills](https://wireedmpro.com.au/edm-drills/): small hole EDM drilling from 0.3 mm to 3.0 mm in hardened metal
- [Quality Assurance](https://wireedmpro.com.au/quality-assurance/): first-article, critical-dimension and batch inspection on calibrated instruments
- [Reverse Engineering](https://wireedmpro.com.au/reverse-engineering/): sample measured, modelled in Mastercam and manufactured turnkey
